name: Dolichochampsa
isnote: Only member of Dolichochampsidae; its fragmentary material leaves its relationships among eusuchians unknown.
sum: Slender-snouted eusuchian from the latest Cretaceous of Argentina and Bolivia.
holotype: Type material of D. minima from the Yacoraite Formation, Argentina (Gasparini & Buffetaut 1980).
material: Fragmentary remains from Argentina and Bolivia.
biology: Too poorly known for statements about its biology.
author: Gasparini and Buffetaut 1980

sources.text: Gasparini, Z; Buffetaut, E. 1980. ''Dolichochampsa minima'', n.g.n.sp., a representative of a new family of eusuchian crocodiles from the Late Cretaceous of northern Argentina.
